verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents its own Model Context Protocol integration for AI assistants and says users can perform actions and analyze data in MailerLite with natural-language prompts in Claude. That covers operating the product by natural-language command. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions and scopes are available through natural language, any native in-app natural-language command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Perform actions in MailerLite and analyze data with natural language prompts in Claude.
Connect AI assistants to MailerLite using Model Context Protocol for seamless integration.
